mechanism: Benztropine's anticholinergic effects may reduce gastric motility and alter tobramycin absorption, while tobramycin's nephrotoxicity risk may be compounded by benztropine's anticholinergic effects on renal perfusion.
action: Monitor renal function closely; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative antiparkinson agent if tobramycin-induced nephrotoxicity develops; assess for urinary retention.
